observational_unit: Three consecutive time windows in one setup; no independent reassembly recorded

definitions.PC: Packet-completion elapsed time on PC; buffering and scheduling may repeat timestamps
definitions.host_ms: Teensy MUL1 construction/enqueue millis timestamp, not direct SPI or physical scan timing
definitions.ESKF: Per-slot logged DELTA_SYNC events; any_ESKF_packet intervals are an interleaved union and are not a module's refresh period. No trigger causes are inferred.
definitions.condition: Recorded zero_load; user confirmed N=2 large-area coverage with simultaneous coverage and loading of M1 and M3. Equal force/area is not established. See condition_correction.json
definitions.provenance: Local file hashes only; no device flash readback
